currency.description: 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the settling currency of the transaction

settled_amount.description: Amount of the transaction that has been settled in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents)

pending_amount.description:
Pending amount of the transaction in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents), including any acquirer fees.

The value of this field will go to zero over time once the financial transaction is settled.

events.description: A list of all financial events that have modified this transfer

from_financial_account_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the financial account or card that will send the funds. Accepted type dependent on the program's use case

to_financial_account_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the financial account or card that will receive the funds. Accepted type dependent on the program's use case

external_id.description: External ID defined by the customer

transaction_series.description: A series of transactions that are grouped together

external_resource.description: An external resource associated with the transfer
